name: run-tests
description: Run the project's test suite and report failures. Supports vitest, jest, and node:test runners. Automatically detects the test runner from package.json.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: Optional test file pattern to filter (e.g., 'users.test.ts'). If omitted, runs all tests.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Test results including pass count, fail count, and failure details.

failureConditions.description: Test runner not found in package.json
failureConditions.signal: npm test exits with code 1 and stderr contains 'no test specified'

failureConditions.description: No test files match the filter
failureConditions.signal: test runner output contains 'no tests found'
